DOKPLOY_ADVERTISE_ADDR.description: Address Docker Swarm advertises (default: the host's first IPv4 address)

DOKPLOY_DOCKER_SWARM_INIT_ARGS.description: Extra 'docker swarm init' flags, e.g. --default-addr-pool 172.20.0.0/16 to avoid clashing with a VPC

DOKPLOY_VERSION.description: Dokploy release tag to install (e.g. v0.26.6, canary); empty = latest stable

DOKPLOY_REMOVE_DOCKER.description: Also remove Docker itself on down (true/false)

ports.name: dokploy_http
ports.note: Dokploy Traefik HTTP, also required for the Lets Encrypt HTTP-01 challenge (fixed by the installer)

ports.name: dokploy_https
ports.note: Dokploy Traefik HTTPS (fixed by the installer)

ports.name: dokploy_ui
ports.note: Dokploy admin UI (fixed by the installer)
